assign.outcome:
**Two rails at one edge now say so.** The nav label under `dev/` read "Dev rail" while the module, the page title and every CSS class said DevBar. [`dev/DevBar/page.js`](/framework/dev/DevBar/) now sets `label: "DevBar"` — verified live: `nav_for()` over `dev/`'s children returns Socket · DevBar · Claim.

The white inspector sidebar beside it is [`ext/drawer`](/framework/ext/drawer/) (the shell — one per document, opened by any caller, shut only by its ✕); the inspector that fills it is `ext/Panel/properties.js`, via `tools.js` on the `panel-focus` event. Both dock at the inline end and **both can be open at once**, so each readme's *Watch out* now names the other in one line and points at the doc that carries the sum: `.app` reserves `--drawer + --devbar`, and the drawer offsets itself by `--devbar` to sit beside the dev rail rather than under it.

Fixed while linking: [`DevBar/doc/docking.md`](/framework/dev/DevBar/doc/docking/) still credited `ext/layout` for the drawer in both of its mentions — the rail moved to `ext/drawer` on 2026-08-16.

Left alone: `ext/layout/readme.md` line 1 still claims "a right-hand drawer" in its own headline. Same staleness, outside this task's fence.
